queue.title: How to Find the Deals in Your monday.com Pipeline That Have Changed Stage But Never Changed Value
queue.brief: A deal that moves through your pipeline without its value being updated is almost certainly being managed by assumption, not reality. This post shows how to find these records and why they are quietly distorting your forecast.
queue.description: Target keyword: "pipeline deal value not updated monday.com." Real-world example: a VP of Sales at a professional services firm who notices their weighted pipeline looks healthy but closed-won revenue keeps coming in lower than forecast — the root cause turns out to be deal values set at qualification that were never revised as scope changed.
